description: This file defines a custom RecyclerView Adapter for displaying a list of text items in an Android application, including a ViewHolder class with click handling.

classes.name: CustomAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter subclass that manages a dataset of strings and creates ViewHolders for displaying text items.

classes.name: CustomAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder subclass that holds a reference to a TextView and sets up a click listener to log clicks.

methods.name: CustomAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a dataset of strings.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder's TextView for a given position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the dataset.

methods.name: ViewHolder
methods.description: Initializes the ViewHolder, sets up click listener, and provides access to the TextView.
